changeSummary: Initial production baseline for 8-parameter clinical facial analysis.

parametersSnapshot.name: Hydration
parametersSnapshot.description: Measurement of epidermal water retention and cellular moisture levels.

interpretation.low: Severe transepidermal water loss. Skin barrier requires humectant infusion.
interpretation.medium: Moderate hydration. Minor dryness in seasonal transitions.
interpretation.high: Optimal barrier hydration with supple cellular volume.

parametersSnapshot.name: Oil Balance
parametersSnapshot.description: Sebum production equilibrium across the T-zone and U-zone facial quadrants.

interpretation.low: Alipic skin lacking essential lipid barrier oils.
interpretation.medium: Balanced lipidic secretion with minimal sheen.
interpretation.high: Hyperactive sebaceous activity leading to congestion.

parametersSnapshot.name: Texture
parametersSnapshot.description: Micro-relief smoothness, cellular turnover rate, and dermal topography regularity.

interpretation.low: Keratinized rough patches and sluggish desquamation.
interpretation.medium: Standard dermal texture with localized minor roughness.
interpretation.high: Silky, ultra-refined micro-topography with luminous light reflection.

parametersSnapshot.name: Pores
parametersSnapshot.description: Follicular pore visibility, dilatation depth, and surrounding elasticity.

interpretation.low: Dilated follicular openings prone to sebaceous filament oxidation.
interpretation.medium: Minimal visible pores localized to the nose and inner cheeks.

parametersSnapshot.name: Pigmentation
parametersSnapshot.description: Melanin dispersion uniformity, solar lentigines, and post-inflammatory erythema.

interpretation.low: Noticeable hyperpigmentation clusters and UV photo-damage spots.
interpretation.medium: Slight localized discolouration and uneven tone.
interpretation.high: Crystal clarity with luminous, uniform complexion tone.

parametersSnapshot.name: Wrinkles
parametersSnapshot.description: Dynamic expression lines, periorbital fine lines, and nasolabial crease depth.

interpretation.low: Pronounced structural dynamic wrinkles requiring peptide support.
interpretation.medium: Early fine dehydration lines around eyes and forehead.

parametersSnapshot.name: Redness
parametersSnapshot.description: Vascular reactivity, capillary fragility, and cutaneous micro-inflammation.

interpretation.low: Significant erythematous flushing and compromised barrier sensitivity.
interpretation.medium: Occasional reactivity to environmental stressors and active acids.
interpretation.high: Calm, resilient micro-vascular tone with zero flush.

parametersSnapshot.name: Firmness
parametersSnapshot.description: Viscoelastic recoil elasticity and dermal collagen network density.

interpretation.low: Loss of dermal matrix tension and early tissue laxity.
interpretation.medium: Good baseline elasticity with minor softening along jawline.
interpretation.high: Plump, high-tensile cellular bounce and defined facial contours.
